_meta.conventions: Strains are fractions (0.04 = 4%). stress_measure says whether a stress value is an amplitude, range (max-min), or max stress. Extra quantities beyond the brief: 'snap_fit_strain_allow' (permissible short-term strain, single snap), 'relaxation_modulus_MPa', 'fatigue_strain_max' (max strain in a strain-controlled test), 'sn_curve_fit' (value null, parameters in 'fit'). No values were derived except unit conversions (psi->MPa, % -> fraction).
_meta.warnings: Almost all FDM fatigue tests run at 1-100 Hz; self-heating at ~300 Hz is a real risk (see POM Volgers note: still vs circulating air changed allowable peak stress 44 -> 55 MPa). Cesnik & Slavic report the opposite trend (longer life at higher frequency) when temperature is held constant (+3 C rise) in a 200-800 Hz vibration test. Run-out in most FDM studies is only 1e6-2e6 cycles, not 1e7+.
